name: BambooHR
description: Employees, time off and onboarding tasks in BambooHR.

objects.label: employees
objects.description: People in the employee directory, current and former.

fields.label: employee ID
fields.description: The number BambooHR assigns. Every write needs it, so keep it when matching people.

fields.label: employment status
fields.description: Active is currently employed. Inactive covers terminated and former employees.

objects.label: time-off requests
objects.description: Requests for time away and whether they were approved.

fields.label: type
fields.description: Time-off types are set per company; these are the common defaults.

objects.label: onboarding tasks
objects.description: Checklist items for a new hire, such as set up a laptop or send the welcome pack.

fields.label: assigned to
fields.description: The person who has to do the task, often someone in IT or the manager.

fields.label: category
fields.description: The task list the item belongs to, such as IT or Payroll.

actions.label: a time-off request
actions.description: Files a request as if the employee had. It still goes to their manager for approval.

params.label: for
params.description: An employee's name or work email, or a piece that holds people.

actions.label: a note
actions.description: A note on the employee's record, visible to HR and the manager. Nothing else changes.

params.label: on
params.description: An employee's name or work email, or a piece that holds people.

guidance: BambooHR is reached through its REST API at the company's own subdomain with an API key that belongs to one user, so the automation can see exactly what that user can see. Pull several fields at once with a custom report rather than one call per employee, and note that field names are internal aliases or numeric IDs, not the labels on screen. Read only the fields the plan names and keep personal data such as pay, home address and dates of birth out of it. Writes are limited on purpose: time-off requests and notes are safe, but hiring, terminating or changing pay should stay a human action in BambooHR.

setup.notes: The BambooHR administrator in HR can create an API key. Ask for one from an account with access limited to the employees and fields in the plan.
